description_en: Re-upgrades devices that failed to upgrade or whose upgrades were canceled in a specified batch
description_zh: 调用该接口重新升级指定批次下升级失败或升级取消的设备升级作业
name: ReupgradeOTATask

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the upgrade batch. This is the JobId returned when you invoke https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147496.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147887.html to create a batch node.

You can also view the Batch ID on the Update Package Details page of the over-the-air update package in the IoT Platform console
parameters.help_zh:
升级批次ID。
您调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147496.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147887.html创建批次任务返回的**JobId**。

您也可以在物联网平台控制台上OTA升级包的升级包详情页面查看批次ID
parameters.name: job_id

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If an ID value is available, you must specify this ID value. Otherwise, the call fails.
If no <props="intl"><ph>Overview page or </ph></props>ID value is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无<props="intl"><ph>实例概览页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the device upgrade task to be re-upgraded. You can specify 1 to 10 TaskId values
parameters.help_zh: 待重新升级的设备升级作业ID。传入TaskId个数范围为1~10个
parameters.name: task_id

Code.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的错误码

ErrorMessage.description_zh: 调用失败时，返回的出错信息

true: The call was successful.

表示是否调用成功。
true：调用成功。
